comment: Generate every hash with `node scripts/check-leaks.js --hash '<term>'` — never by hand-hashing the raw term (separator terms hashed by hand will silently never match). hashedTerms are single-token entries (n=1); hashedPhrases are {n, hash} of space-joined token sequences. Committed hashes carry ONLY higher-entropy brand/product identifiers whose reversal reveals nothing sensitive; person names, short numeric ids, and common words live exclusively in the LEAK_EXTRA_TERMS CI secret (and maintainers' local LEAK_EXTRA_DENYLIST file) because unsalted sha256 of short terms is reversible by offline guessing. Consequence, accepted deliberately: fork PRs (no secrets) are gated only by the committed subset; maintainers re-check on merge. Patterns catch generic secret shapes.
